record.reason: Generic transfer-learning main contribution: fMRI response prediction validates intermediate feature mappings, and individual semantic-perception correlations test retention of an established neuroscience observation. Main evaluations and conclusions target CNN generalization for scene, impression and advertising behavior. Exclusion is based on main research focus, not absence of a clinical endpoint; genuine neural data and cognitive analyses remain acknowledged.

Primary contribution and all evaluated endpoints concern card-game information seeking and general cognitive behavior, with no medical, disease, clinical mental-health, neurobiological or other biomedical primary experiment. Health software and diagnosis are prospective examples only. Independent PDF pages 1–7 re-review supersedes earlier broad cognitive-science inclusion.

record.rationale: COVID and hospital policy simulations are substantial, but independent supply-chain simulator and intervention experiments are co-primary. Keep pending under biomedical-main-focus standard.
Real embryoid-body and simulated cell trajectories are substantial, alongside an independent N-body particle-tracking main task. Keep both branches visible and scope pending.
